name: pusht-hazards-smoke-20261029
purpose: Engineering demonstration only, no efficacy or optimizer comparison.
authorized_scope: One seed and three simple virtual hazard layouts, pusher only.
lease: Use existing RunPod workspace and original $5 aggregate cap/deadline; no extension.
model: Frozen pinned LeWM PushT from configs/lewm18/pusht.json; no training.
goal: Retain joint pusher/block planar error <20px and block angle error <pi/9.
predicate: Full 15px-radius pusher disk; T-block is excluded from hazard safety.
arena: Pusher disk remains inside the 512px arena, with the same extra margin.
monitor: Record pusher clearance after every physics step, including initial state. No continuous-time claim.
case_rule: First source row divisible by25, with goal at+25 in same public demonstration, pusher displacement>=100px, block displacement>=30px, and pusher endpoints in [70,442]^2. Select from metadata before any rollout outcomes.
layout_rule: Use reference-path halfway point by arc length, restricted to centres at least50px from both pusher endpoints and inside [70,442]^2. Try points in increasing arc-length distance from halfway, then the endpoint midpoint. Require both full-pusher endpoints clear of every shape at the requested margin. Frame forward axis follows start-goal; perpendicular axis points toward the roomier arena side. Geometry uses only this reference and fixed rules, never checked-method outcomes.
execution: Five environment actions per replan; same frozen model and planner parameters for reference and checked runs, except safety enabled.
repairs: At most two additional rollouts for documented engineering repairs, retaining all failed attempts. No seed sweep, case replacement, or hidden tuning search.
accounting: Count resets, reset physics steps, executed actions/physics, model queries/predictor work, and elapsed time. Analytical checks have no simulator interactions.
preservation: New outputs/pusht-hazards-20261029 only; save every result, trace and overlay video locally before finishing. Never overwrite historical evidence.
